summary: @mhawksey I think so called web 2.0 promise isn't there because it was always a delusion. We traded privacy for a friction-free experiment and watched VC #edtech companies go belly up. Let's start building tools so students can do this all from their own blogs and websites.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @mhawksey I think so called web 2.0 promise isn't there because it was always a delusion. We traded privacy for a friction-free experiment and watched VC #edtech companies go belly up. Let's start building tools so students can do this all from their own blogs and websites.
